name: Notifio – Back in Stock Waitlist for WooCommerce
author: Muhammad Umar

sections.description:
Notifio adds a “Notify Me When Available” form to every out-of-stock product page. Customers enter their email — and when stock returns, you notify them with one click.

Every out-of-stock product page is a lost sale. Notifio turns those dead ends into a list of warm buyers ready to purchase.

Features

  • ✅ “Notify Me When Available” form on out-of-stock products
  • ✅ Email collected and stored securely in your database
  • ✅ One-click “Notify All” button in the product editor
  • ✅ Waitlist management table under WooCommerce → Waitlist
  • ✅ Confirmation email sent to subscriber on sign-up
  • ✅ Customisable button text, placeholder, and success message
  • ✅ Optional name field on the signup form
  • ✅ GDPR-friendly — all data stored on your server
  • ✅ WooCommerce HPOS compatible
  • ✅ Works with Storefront, Astra, OceanWP, Flatsome, and Divi

Who is this for?

  • WooCommerce stores that regularly run out of stock
  • Stores launching new products and collecting pre-launch interest
  • Any store that loses customers when a product shows “Out of Stock”

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. When a product goes out of stock, the “Notify Me” form appears automatically
  3. Customers sign up — you see them in WooCommerce → Waitlist
  4. When stock returns, click “Notify All” to email every subscriber instantly
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Waitlist Settings to configure
  4. The form appears automatically on out-of-stock products
sections.faq:
Does this work with variable products?

Yes. The waitlist form appears on variable products when a variation is out of stock.

Where is the subscriber data stored?

All data is stored in your WordPress database. No data is sent to any third-party servers.

Will the form appear automatically?

Yes. As long as a product is marked “Out of stock” in WooCommerce, the form appears automatically. No shortcodes needed.

Can I customise the form?

Yes. Button text, email placeholder, and success message are all customisable in WooCommerce → Waitlist Settings.

Does it work with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. The plugin declares full compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

What happens if a customer is already on the waitlist?

They see the same success message — we never reveal if their email was already registered.
